summaries_original.es: Modelos de Google DeepMind predijeron con una semana de antelación la formación de la tormenta Isaías y el NHC los integra en sus pronósticos, aunque la decisión final sigue en manos de especialistas.

stories.summary_en: The US National Hurricane Center began using Google DeepMind's AI model in 2026 for some track and intensity consensus aids and is working with the company on a successor model. NHC operations chief Dan Brown says human forecasters still make the final forecast decisions.
stories.title: AI sharpens hurricane forecasts, but humans still call the shots
stories.value_added: Improves hurricane track and intensity consensus aids, with human forecasters retaining decision authority.

summaries_original.ja: 10月の台風30号では、従来の物理モデルの予測が大きくぶれた一方、AIモデルは早い段階で日本列島方向へのカーブを正しく示したと報じられています。

stories.summary_en: The article reports that AI typhoon forecasting models are gaining accuracy and are being adopted by private companies, while the Japan Meteorological Agency is also researching them. During Typhoon No. 30 in October, AI models correctly indicated an early recurve toward Japan, whereas conventional physical models diverged significantly.
stories.title: AI typhoon forecasts gaining accuracy: adopted by private sector, Japan Meteorological Agency also researching
stories.value_added: AI models showed the recurve toward the Japanese archipelago earlier than conventional physical models, which varied widely for Typhoon No. 30 in October.

sources.title: Unrealistic emissions scenarios help AI climate models prepare for unfamiliar futures
sources.title_en: Unrealistic emissions scenarios help AI climate models prepare for unfamiliar futures

stories.summary_en: MIT researchers developed a technique to streamline the production of fast, trustworthy and adaptable AI models for climate prediction. The work uses unrealistic emissions scenarios to help AI climate models prepare for unfamiliar future conditions. The aim is to support planning decisions in power grid resilience, public health and agriculture.
stories.title: Unrealistic emissions scenarios help AI climate models prepare for unfamiliar futures
stories.value_added: Streamlines production of fast, trustworthy and adaptable AI models for climate prediction, supporting planning for grid resilience, public health and agriculture.

stories.summary_en: A study published in the Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems describes AI research aimed at extreme weather forecasts up to six weeks ahead. stories.value_added: AI research aims at extreme weather forecasts up to six weeks ahead and performed much better than conventional approaches in forecasting a landfall near Destin, Florida.

stories.value_added: AI forecasts delivered by text message to tens of millions of farmers gave early warning of an unusual stall in seasonal rains.

sources.title: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe
sources.title_en: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe

stories.summary_en: Vaisala Xweather has unveiled Met-in-a-box, a compact AI weather forecasting system aimed at national meteorological services, governments and enterprises. The system requires no supercomputer and is said to run forecasts 40,000 times faster than traditional numerical prediction. It is positioned to make AI-based forecasting accessible to NMHSs worldwide.
stories.title: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe
stories.value_added: Runs forecasts 40,000 times faster than traditional numerical prediction without requiring a supercomputer.

sources.title_en: Scientists just broke through a major barrier in weather forecasting

stories.summary_en: Scientists developed an AI-based post-processing method that improves weather forecasts three to four weeks ahead, giving earlier warnings of extreme weather. The method was tested on three forecasting systems, including ECMWF's models. The value added is extended forecast lead time for extreme weather warning.
stories.title: Scientists just broke through a major barrier in weather forecasting
stories.value_added: Improves weather forecasts three to four weeks ahead, offering earlier warnings of extreme weather.

sources.title: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days
sources.title_en: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days

stories.summary_en: Colorado State University's team combined an NVIDIA-based model, Hail-StormScope, with a CSU machine-learning model to forecast ice and hail storms. The system is reported to already increase warning times and update impact areas as storms evolve, offering longer lead times for hazard warnings in the United States.
stories.title: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days
stories.value_added: Increases warning times and updates impact areas as storms change, for ice and hail storm forecasts.

sources.title_en: From observations to forecasts: bringing AI-DOP into real time
